title: M-XR Image-to-Material Production PBR Generation
summary: A foundational AI model that generates production-grade PBR material maps from a single image or video. It leverages proprietary measured data to produce physically accurate textures for 3D rendering and game engines.
research_notes: Trained on the 'Marso Measure' dataset, the world's largest library of measured material properties. The company raised $7M in 2026 to scale its material intelligence infrastructure.

evolution.summary: The project transitioned from a capture service into the I2M foundational model and API. It is now integrated into the Marso Studio platform, focusing on automated PBR generation and retexturing of photogrammetry assets.
